name: kinesis
description: Amazon Kinesis Data Streams Service API Reference Amazon Kinesis Data Streams is a managed service that scales elastically for real-time processing of streaming big data.

subcommands.name: add-tags-to-stream
subcommands.description: Adds or updates tags for the specified Kinesis data stream.

subcommands.name: create-stream
subcommands.description: Creates a Kinesis data stream.

subcommands.name: decrease-stream-retention-period
subcommands.description: Decreases the Kinesis data stream's retention period, which is the length of time data records are accessible after they are added to the stream.

subcommands.name: delete-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Delete a policy for the specified data stream or consumer.

subcommands.name: delete-stream
subcommands.description: Deletes a Kinesis data stream and all its shards and data.

subcommands.name: deregister-stream-consumer
subcommands.description: To deregister a consumer, provide its ARN.

subcommands.name: describe-account-settings
subcommands.description: Describes the account-level settings for Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.

subcommands.name: describe-limits
subcommands.description: Describes the shard limits and usage for the account.

subcommands.name: describe-stream
subcommands.description: Describes the specified Kinesis data stream.

subcommands.name: describe-stream-consumer
subcommands.description: To get the description of a registered consumer, provide the ARN of the consumer.

subcommands.name: describe-stream-summary
subcommands.description: Provides a summarized description of the specified Kinesis data stream without the shard list.

subcommands.name: disable-enhanced-monitoring
subcommands.description: Disables enhanced monitoring.

subcommands.name: enable-enhanced-monitoring
subcommands.description: Enables enhanced Kinesis data stream monitoring for shard-level metrics.

subcommands.name: get-records
subcommands.description: Gets data records from a Kinesis data stream's shard.

subcommands.name: get-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Returns a policy attached to the specified data stream or consumer.

subcommands.name: get-shard-iterator
subcommands.description: Gets an Amazon Kinesis shard iterator.

subcommands.name: increase-stream-retention-period
subcommands.description: Increases the Kinesis data stream's retention period, which is the length of time data records are accessible after they are added to the stream.

subcommands.name: list-shards
subcommands.description: Lists the shards in a stream and provides information about each shard.

subcommands.name: list-stream-consumers
subcommands.description: Lists the consumers registered to receive data from a stream using enhanced fan-out, and provides information about each consumer.

subcommands.name: list-streams
subcommands.description: Lists your Kinesis data streams.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List all tags added to the specified Kinesis resource.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-stream
subcommands.description: Lists the tags for the specified Kinesis data stream.

subcommands.name: merge-shards
subcommands.description: Merges two adjacent shards in a Kinesis data stream and combines them into a single shard to reduce the stream's capacity to ingest and transport data.

subcommands.name: put-record
subcommands.description: Writes a single data record into an Amazon Kinesis data stream.

subcommands.name: put-records
subcommands.description: Writes multiple data records into a Kinesis data stream in a single call (also referred to as a PutRecords request).

subcommands.name: put-resource-policy
subcommands.description: Attaches a resource-based policy to a data stream or registered consumer.

subcommands.name: register-stream-consumer
subcommands.description: Registers a consumer with a Kinesis data stream.

subcommands.name: remove-tags-from-stream
subcommands.description: Removes tags from the specified Kinesis data stream.

subcommands.name: split-shard
subcommands.description: Splits a shard into two new shards in the Kinesis data stream, to increase the stream's capacity to ingest and transport data.

subcommands.name: start-stream-encryption
subcommands.description: Enables or updates server-side encryption using an Amazon Web Services KMS key for a specified stream.

subcommands.name: stop-stream-encryption
subcommands.description: Disables server-side encryption for a specified stream.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or updates tags for the specified Kinesis resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from the specified Kinesis resource.

subcommands.name: update-account-settings
subcommands.description: Updates the account-level settings for Amazon Kinesis Data Streams.

subcommands.name: update-max-record-size
subcommands.description: This allows you to update the MaxRecordSize of a single record that you can write to, and read from a stream.

subcommands.name: update-shard-count
subcommands.description: Updates the shard count of the specified stream to the specified number of shards.

subcommands.name: update-stream-mode
subcommands.description: Updates the capacity mode of the data stream.

subcommands.name: update-stream-warm-throughput
subcommands.description: Updates the warm throughput configuration for the specified Amazon Kinesis Data Streams on-demand data stream.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: stream-exists
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query StreamDescription.StreamStatus returns ACTIVE when polling with ``describe-stream``.

subcommands.name: stream-not-exists
subcommands.description: Wait until ResourceNotFoundException is thrown when polling with ``describe-stream``.
